course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Use connector choice to summarize a problem and give a short viewpoint.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A local transport change affects commuting and everyday errands.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining cause, consequence, contrast, and a practical preference.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a temporary change to bus routes, summarize its consequences, and decide which travel option is most reasonable.

main_focus.name: cohesive connectors for cause, consequence, contrast, and conclusion
main_focus.description: Use connectors to organize a short practical argument about transport choices.
model_examples: Bussen går mer sällan, därför tar resan längre tid.
Det är dyrare med taxi, däremot sparar vi tid.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 4-6 connectors naturally, with at least one cause, one contrast, and one conclusion.

avoid_grammar: new complex grammar as the main load

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use transport vocabulary and connectors to support a clear practical choice.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker shares information about a transport disruption.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare two travel options using cause, contrast, and consequence language.
dialogue_shape.ending: They state the preferred option and summarize why it is most reasonable.

target_complexity.repetition: recycle connector frames with different information, not the same sentence pattern only

focus: the transport problem and its consequence
the contrast between the two travel options
which option is preferred and why

sentence_focus: one sentence with därför showing consequence
one sentence with däremot showing contrast
one sentence with Å ena sidan
one sentence with Å andra sidan
